MT8188 Mali-G57 MC3 GPU is not reaching its rated 850 MHz peak frequency. Panfrost reports OPP set failures:

dmesg:
  [  5.200] panfrost: GPU OPP table has 3 entries
  [  5.201] panfrost: OPP 850MHz: Failed to set, regulator VGPU at 850mV (required 900mV)
  [  5.202] panfrost: clamping to max achievable OPP: 700MHz

device-tree GPU OPP table shows 850MHz@850mV but the regulator can only deliver up to 850mV. This is the panfrost-mt8188-opp-mismatch failure mode. How do we diagnose whether this is a DT error or a hardware limitation, and what is the proper fix?
